about: Every change made when the six pieces moved from geometer.dev's Journal (migration/geometer-articles.json) to content/pieces/en. Words, dates, labels, summaries, sections, examples and endings are unchanged; only these addresses and ids changed, because the pieces now live on journal.streetlist.in. tests/migration.test.ts applies exactly these maps and nothing else.

topics.about: geometer.dev's five topics to the Journal's five sections (owner, 14 Nov 2026).

links.about: Addresses in sources and endings. A piece that moved links to its new page here; a piece that stayed with Geometer keeps its geometer.dev address (the website job redirects it when the technical notes move); support goes to the one public address.

images.about: Lead pictures now sit in content/media (Pages CMS's media folder) and are written as /media/<file>.

dropped.about: Keys geometer.dev needed and the Journal does not: every piece had these exact values.

related: Pieces that moved stay in 'related' (the Keep reading cards). Pieces that stayed with Geometer move to 'elsewhere': their title (from geometer.dev's articles.json) and their geometer.dev address, shown under Keep reading.
added: Each piece gains a 'companion' (a face from src/characters/cast.ts and the mood it shows); it is new, so the test does not compare it.

stayedBehind.about: Titles of the related pieces that stayed with Geometer, as geometer.dev had them.
stayedBehind.what-you-depend-on: What you depend on when you build on Geometer
stayedBehind.lost-acknowledgements: A timeout is not a failed refund.
stayedBehind.exact-call-approval: Approve the action that will happen.
